scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'].forEach(f => { try { fs.unlinkSync(f) } catch {} }); const agent = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; if (!/^pnpm\//.test(agent)) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
